claim_ceiling: Constrained hierarchical Leiden (min_cluster_size=10 + adaptive sub_resolution) on 174k TF-IDF embeddings produces a valid multi-resolution hierarchy with perfect nesting (1.0 by construction), zero fragmentation (<0.1% singletons), and measurable zoom refinement (branch purity delta +0.03 to +0.09, improvement_rate 57-90%). Dense embeddings at 99k (2000-2015) PASS v26 with coarse_res=0.15-0.2 (improvement_rate 55.6-58.8%, zero fragmentation, branch purity 0.98+). 3-year dense (2000-2002, 12.5k) confirms method generalization with expected scale-dependent fragmentation (14-41% singletons). Citation-role embeddings (citing/following_alpha0.3) achieve 100% improvement_rate at 1k. All TF-IDF modes product-integrated at 174k. Lane BLOCKED on legal-distance 174k dense embeddings (3/26 years ACCEPTED).
evidence_summary: 4 TF-IDF modes at 174k: constrained_hierarchical_174k_full/hybrid05/hybrid07/regeste_20260926.json (all PASS v26, improvement_rate 57-90%, nesting=1.0, singletons <0.1%). 99k dense coarse_res sweep: dense_99k_coarse_sweep_summary_20260927_053745.json + 4 detail files (PASS at 0.15/0.2, FAIL at 0.25/0.3). 3-year dense: constrained_hierarchical_dense_3yr_results.json (nesting=1.0, branch Δ up to +0.14, area Δ up to +0.30, singletons 14-41%). Citation roles 1k: constrained_hierarchical_citation_roles_1k_20260927_042054.json (citing/following 100% improvement_rate, criticizing fails due to sparsity). Debiased_citation_blended 1k: constrained_hierarchical_debiased_citation_blended_1k_20260927_042141.json (50% improvement_rate, zero fragmentation). Flat v26 174k: v26_verdict.json (0/4 TF-IDF modes PASS, >99% fragmentation). Nesting defect: CYCLE_36027099305_GATE.json (PASS). Product integration: product_integration_174k/ (4 modes, complete artifacts). All negative results preserved. Factory direction discrepancy noted and corrected (v30 claimed 16/26 years, actual 3/26 ACCEPTED).
